title: patient.dsr.export_ready.v1
description: The package of an access request is stored (encrypted with the clinic's key) and its OTP-protected secure link was requested (PLT-047, DsrExportService.build, from DsrExportJob); subject = the request. The link token never travels in an event. Consumers comms-gateway (the WhatsApp itself is comms.notification.requested.v1, purpose secure_link): log-only handler until it exists.
